title: The performance of multiple language models in identifying offensive language on social media
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance and classification accuracy of various language models (such as BERT and ALBERT) in detecting offensive content. It includes a procedural appendix on 'Ethical Issues Addressed' that covers data privacy and anonymization but does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks within the models. While religion and religious belief are mentioned as potential target categories for offensive language, they are not a focus of the evaluation itself.
